communications.subject: Iowa Open Records Law Request: Flock Safety agreements and amendments
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to Iowa Code Chapter 22, I request electronic copies of the following records concerning agreements between the City of West Des Moines and/or West Des Moines Police Department and Flock Group, Inc. / Flock Safety:

The executed June 23, 2020 Flock agreement, including its attached terms, exhibits, order form, and statement of work.
The executed April 4, 2023 Government Agency Customer Agreement and all order forms or exhibits incorporated into that agreement.
The executed July 2023 amendment / Amendment Order Form / Additional Services Agreement modifying the April 4, 2023 agreement.
Any other executed amendment, renewal, extension, replacement agreement, order form, additional-services agreement, data-processing addendum, privacy addendum, or information-security addendum governing Flock services from June 23, 2020 through the present.

For clarity, I am seeking the contractual instruments governing the relationship, not correspondence discussing them.

I am not requesting deployment plans, camera-location maps, precise camera-location records, or other records whose principal purpose is to identify specific device locations.

Please provide the records in their native electronic format where available rather than printed-to-PDF scans.

If any responsive record contains material you believe is exempt from disclosure, please provide the nonexempt portions and identify the statutory basis for any withholding or redaction.

If fulfilling this request is expected to exceed $25, please provide an itemized estimate before incurring additional cost.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Auberg

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley

title: Arvada PD ALPR Policy & Audit Documents

communications.subject: Colorado Open Records Act Request: Arvada PD ALPR Policy & Audit Documents
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Per the Arvada Police Department Policy Manual:

Section 460.4.1 states: "Documentation of designees or contractors who are authorized/to use or access the ALPR system, to collect ALPR information, or to service the ALPR system."
1) Please provide all documentation matching this description.

Section 460.4.1 item a) and Section 460.5 item d) state: "Training requirements for authorized users" and "No member of this Department shall operate ALPR equipment or access ALPR data without first completing Department-approved training", respectively. 
2) Please provide all training requirements for authorized users of the ALPR system, and provide all Department-approved training.

460.4.1 item c) states: "Proper documentation and reporting to any grant-funding authorities for ALPR systems."
3) Please provide a list of grants applied to for funding ALPR systems.

460.6 (b) 3) mentions 2 distinct systems where data is stored in 2 different ways, one way for systems owned by Arvada PD and one for leased systems.
4) Please provide a list of all ALPR systems used by Arvada PD.
5) Please provide documentation establishing retention policy for both owned-systems and also for leased systems

460.7 e) states: "ALPR system audits should be conducted on a regular basis."
6) Please provide a list of all Audits that have been conducted of any ALPR system from Jan 1, 2023 to the time this request is processed
7) Please provide all documents associated with any audit of any of Arvada PD's ALPR systems

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

William Beckett
